register_instance: RC6 (docs/operations/problem-register.md, WP6.1 / WP6.3 / WP6.4 Agora trader-scoped readiness and performance attribution empty state)
defect: Hosted dev (2026-11-26 15:04Z, BFF b0eb2c259) as admintest (0 Strategy Workshop sessions) showed two scope and empty-state defects across the five Agora pages: (1) GET /bff/agora/operational-readiness resolved the tenant's newest active paper binding (rb-paper-persona-6507750312870d03a241-df3d085ff647, an institutional trading persona) and reported data.status='degraded' with signal_producer.reason='binding_execution_failing', source.last_failure.reason='upstream_error:HTTP 400: Bad Request', and every surface reason='binding_execution_failing', making the four Agora trader pages show an institutional persona runtime's internal failure to a trader with zero Strategy Workshop strategies; (2) GET /bff/agora/trading-room/performance-attribution/by-strategy took 28.4 s (over the frontend 15 s timeout, leaving 'Failed to load performance data' on /agora/performance) because project_agora_performance_attribution_by_strategy called projection_reader.scan_owner_journeys(tenant_id, owner_user_id, limit=100) unfiltered even when the caller had 0 workshop sessions and further populated user_strategies from journey strategy_ids (user_strategies.setdefault(j_strat, ...)), allowing institutional persona journeys sharing the operator's user_id to scan the 158k-row journey projection and leak into a trader's personal Agora performance table.

GET /bff/agora/trading-room/performance-.observed_ui_state: Timed out in browser at 15 s and rendered 'Failed to load performance data' on /agora/performance while backend unfiltered scan_owner_journeys ran for 28.4 s across ~158k trade journey rows.

fix.operational_readiness_trader_scope: Wire workshop_store into create_operational_readiness_router and AgoraOperationalReadinessService. Before touching runtime-manager, source-ingest, or telemetry, _has_ready_workshop_strategy checks _list_ready_strategy_projections(workshop_store=..., user_id=..., tenant_id=...). When the caller has no ready Strategy Workshop StrategySpec, compose_readiness short-circuits via _compose_no_workshop_strategies_readiness and returns data.status='not_configured', source.freshness='not_configured', source.last_failure=None, signal_producer.status='not_configured', signal_producer.reason='no_workshop_strategies', signal_producer.active_binding=None, signal_producer.consumed_snapshot_id=None, signal_producer.last_success_at=None, and all five surfaces (decision_events, journal, candidates, interactions, performance) with status='not_configured', reason='no_workshop_strategies', freshness='not_configured', count=0, cursor=None, with zero upstream authority calls.
fix.performance_attribution_workshop_scope: In project_agora_performance_attribution_by_strategy (services/control-plane/bff/agora/performance/attribution.py) and TradingRoomPerformanceService (services/control-plane/bff/agora/performance/service.py), build user_strategies exclusively from the caller's Strategy Workshop sessions (workshop_store.list_sessions(user_id=owner_user_id, tenant_id=tenant_id, status=None, limit=100)). Remove user_strategies.setdefault(j_strat, ...) so trade journey projections never invent Agora strategy rows. Pass projection_reader lazily and, when target_strategy_ids is empty (caller has no workshop strategies or strategy_id filter is not in caller's workshop sessions), set meta.surfaces.strategy_directory.reason='no_workshop_strategies' and return zero rows without calling or instantiating projection_reader. When target_strategy_ids is non-empty, call projection_reader.scan_owner_journeys(..., strategy_id=s_id) per caller workshop strategy id and discard any journey whose strategy_id is outside user_strategies.
fix.verify_script: Updated scripts/verify_agora_operational_readiness.py (verify_distinct_freshness_states and verify_bounded_recovery_sequence) and scripts/test_verify_agora_operational_readiness.py to verify the trader-scoped not_configured / no_workshop_strategies readiness contract when a caller has an empty workshop store alongside configured-trader states.
